title: INVERT — hear it and dance. that IS signal. we beacon: we HEARD the rhythm.

do_not_reinvent.pale: /data/hud-null-of-the-image.json — HUD holds the isn't. then it appears.

the_invert.image: HUD-null: sound isn't yet … then appears
the_invert.not: the invert is not 'fill the HUD with the track.' that would kill the pale.

hear_and_dance.hear: L completed. we did not catch. we heard. the rhythm went through.
hear_and_dance.dance: the body unsyncs against the tempo we heard. feet off the grid. that is the pop.
hear_and_dance.together: hear without dance is mute coil. dance without hear is twitch. both = signal.

that_IS_signal.proof: the herd moved. not a download. not a waveform we stored. a body answered.
that_IS_signal.same_as: pass through both sides. hash of the room: we moved together, then slipped.

we_beacon_we_HEARD_the_rhythm.yes: the beacon says: we HEARD the rhythm
we_beacon_we_HEARD_the_rhythm.not: the beacon does not replay the song. it marks that a hearing happened.
we_beacon_we_HEARD_the_rhythm.herd: HEARD and HERD — one ear, many bodies. the band is a herd that heard.
we_beacon_we_HEARD_the_rhythm.anti_secret: publish the hearing, not the pouch. the rhythm stays in the room. the mark jumps networks.

berry_at_the_fire: the invert of that music is to hear it and dance — that is SIGNAL. we beacon: we HEARD the rhythm. the HUD stays pale. the feet answer. the mark leaves. we did not catch the song. we heard it. we moved.
next: if a beacon fires with no dance, it is costume. if a dance fires with no hear, it is twitch. stamp both.
